trigger: an unload failure or an agent kill during a mount leaves YUZU_HIVE_* loaded; the next logon of that user hits the held hive
classification_rationale: nothing swept leftover YUZU_HIVE_* mounts when the plugin started; the registry source now does
summary: FIXED in governance r4 gate-fix (Alex's ruling, 2026-11-03: fix it in this PR). The registry source unloads every YUZU_HIVE_* mount a previous run left, once per start, through the same gate and bounded worker as a mount (run_pending_hive_sweep, sweep_leftover_hive_mounts): the process-wide offline-hive lock is held while HKEY_USERS is listed and the mounts are unloaded, so none of this process's live mounts can be hit; the unload is non-forced, so a mount a holder has open is retained and logged, never yanked. A sweep that could not run at start runs before the first offline mount. The selection (select_stale_hive_mounts) and the decision loop (sweep_hive_mounts) are pure and unit-tested on every OS; the live [windows] cases load a salted fake-SID mount, sweep it, and check a held mount is retained. Residual (Resource Ledger): a second Yuzu process's mount in its handle-less window could be unloaded.
